description:
BenchBox bypasses dsqgen's official multi-stream mode and hand-rolls TPC-DS
throughput stream ordering and per-stream parameters. This is the core
compliance gap; two symptoms and the root cause:

ROOT CAUSE -- dsqgen -STREAMS is never used. dsqgen (the official binary) has
a -STREAMS N mode (with -INPUT templates.lst) that emits the official
per-stream query ORDERING and the official per-stream substitution PARAMETERS
in a single invocation. BenchBox never calls it (grep: no -STREAMS anywhere).
Instead, DSQGenBinary.generate (benchbox/core/tpcds/c_tools.py:161-259) calls
dsqgen ONE query template at a time (`-TEMPLATE queryN.tpl -RNGSEED <seed>
-FILTER Y`), and the higher layers reconstruct streams by hand:

1. HOME-GROWN ORDERING: stream query order comes from a deterministic swap
   with hardcoded PERMUTATION_SEED = 19620718 in
   benchbox/core/tpcds/streams.py (TPCDS_STANDARD mode, ~lines 77-104), NOT the
   official dsqgen permutation. (TPC-H by contrast uses the real 41x22
   PERMUTATION_MATRIX from permute.h, benchbox/core/tpch/streams.py:39-81.)
2. HOME-GROWN PER-STREAM PARAMETERS: stream_id passed to generate() never
   reaches dsqgen; it only seeds a Python RNG jitter in
   _generate_parameter_variations (c_tools.py:437+,
   `effective_seed = base_seed*7919 + stream_id*3037`). So per-stream parameter
   diversity is invented in Python, not produced by dsqgen's stream seeding.

SECONDARY -- suspicious per-stream regeneration:
TPCDSThroughputTest._build_stream_queries
(benchbox/core/tpcds/throughput_test.py:264-293) calls
`create_standard_streams(num_streams=stream_id + 1, base_seed=seed +
stream_id)` then picks `streams.get(stream_id, [])`. Each stream regenerates
the full set with a DIFFERENT num_streams and a shifted seed, so a stream's
ordering depends on its index rather than the run's stream count -- looks
unintended vs TPC-H's single PERMUTATION_MATRIX[stream_id % 41] index.

FIX DIRECTION: adopt `dsqgen -STREAMS N` to generate all throughput streams in
one call. This simultaneously (a) restores official ordering + official
per-stream substitution parameters (compliance), and (b) collapses the
per-query subprocess spawns into ONE generation pass -- directly serving
throughput-pregenerate-query-streams (which needs streams materialized before
the timed window anyway). Retire the home-grown permutation and RNG jitter for
the throughput path.

This is soundness-critical (query ordering + substitution parameters feed the
QphDS compliance story) -- back every change with a dsqgen-output diff.

anti_patterns.dont: keep the home-grown permutation as the throughput default once -STREAMS works
anti_patterns.instead: adopt dsqgen's ordering and back it with a checked-in output diff.

preserves.behavior: Deterministic, reproducible streams for a fixed (num_streams, seed) — now anchored to dsqgen output rather than the Python permutation.
Single-query get_query (non-throughput uses like power/dry-run) keeps working via the existing per-template path.

benchbox/core/tpcds/c_tools.py:DSQGenBinary._build_dsqgen_cmd — current single-template dsqgen invocation; extend to a -STREAMS N / -INPUT templates.lst batch mode.
benchbox/core/tpcds/c_tools.py:_generate_parameter_variations — the home-grown per-stream RNG jitter that -STREAMS makes unnecessary.

benchbox/core/tpch/streams.py:generate_streams — TPC-H already shells qgen to emit per-stream .sql files; mirror that batch shape for dsqgen -STREAMS.
docs/benchmarks/tpc-ds.md:330-342 — documents PermutationMode (sequential/random/tpcds); update when behavior changes.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit -k 'tpcds and (stream or permut)' -v
verifications.description: Per-stream ordering is stable and spec-justified

work_units.notes:
Run `dsqgen -STREAMS N -INPUT q/templates.lst -DIRECTORY q -SCALE ... -RNGSEED ...`
with the bundled binary; capture to /tmp/tpcds-perm-w0.log and summarize
the ordering + parameter differences vs streams.py + _generate_parameter_variations.
work_units.summary: Confirm bundled dsqgen -STREAMS N output: capture official ordering + per-stream parameters and diff against the current home-grown output
Add a dsqgen -STREAMS batch path in DSQGenBinary and route throughput stream generation through it
Retire the home-grown ordering + RNG jitter for the throughput path; fix _build_stream_queries's stream_id+1 regeneration
Add tests pinning per-stream ordering AND substitution parameters to dsqgen -STREAMS output for a fixed (num_streams, seed)
